title: Dixieland versus ragtime versus jazz
summary: They discuss two-beat versus four-beat playing, what Dixieland and ragtime meant, and why today's bands are not playing real Dixieland.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
